operation.description:
MUTATING operation. Verify target and authorized intent; reconcile outcome before retry. Updates an existing package. The package is identified by the **`id` in the request body** — this endpoint uses the same URL as *Add New Package*.

### `id` selects the record
A body **without** `id` creates a new package instead of updating one, and still replies with an "Added Successfully" message. Always send `id`.

### Only the fields you send are changed — with two exceptions
Fields you leave out keep their current values. The exceptions are the two reference fields:

| Field | Left out of the body |
|---|---|
| `branch_id` | **Set to `null`** — the package loses its branch and stops appearing in *Get All Packages* |
| `product_id` | **Set to `null`** — the package is unlinked from its product |

So resend `branch_id` and `product_id` on every update, even when they are not changing.

### Clearing a text value
Sending `null` for `name`, `description`, `price`, `period_value`, `period_unit`, `status` or `type` leaves the current value untouched. Send an empty string (`""`) to clear a text field.

### Send `Accept: application/json`
This endpoint answers with a redirect to a web page instead of JSON when the request does not ask for JSON. Always send `Accept: application/json`.

### Other notes
- A successful update replies `Package Added Successfully` — the same wording as a create. Do not read it as proof that a new package was inserted; check the `id` you sent.
- An `id` that does not exist returns `400` with `"error": "Record Not Found"`, not `404`.
- Body keys that are not package fields are ignored silently — a misspelled field name is not reported as an error.
- `modified` is refreshed automatically; `created` and `deleted_at` should be omitted.
- Values are not validated against the lists below before they reach the database, so an out-of-range value fails as a save error rather than a field-level validation error.

id.description: Id of the package to update. **Required** — without it a new package is created.

name.description: Package name. Optional — unchanged when omitted.

period_value.description: How many `period_unit` intervals the package covers. Optional — unchanged when omitted.

period_unit.description:
The unit the validity period is counted in. Optional — unchanged when omitted.

| Value | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `daily` | Days |
| `weekly` | Weeks |
| `monthly` | Months |
| `yearly` | Years |
| `not-expired` | Never expires |

price.description: Package price; decimals are allowed. Optional — unchanged when omitted.

type.description:
What the package sells. Optional — unchanged when omitted.

| Value | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `credit_charge` | A bundle of credits |
| `membership` | A membership subscription |

status.description:
Whether the package can be sold. Optional — unchanged when omitted.

| Value | Meaning |
|---|---|
| 0 | Inactive |
| 1 | Active |

description.description: Free-text description. Optional — unchanged when omitted. Send `""` to clear it.

product_id.description: Id of the product the package is linked to. **Resend on every update** — when omitted it is set to `null`.

branch_id.description: Branch the package belongs to. **Resend on every update** — when omitted it is set to `null` and the package stops appearing in *Get All Packages*.

message.description: Confirmation message. Uses the create wording even for an update.

id.description: Id of the package that was updated — the value you sent.

message.description: `Entity not saved` when the update could not be applied — the `id` does not exist, or a value fell outside an allowed list. `Plugin is not installed` when the Points & Credits add-on is not active for the account.

error.description: Reason for the failure — `Record Not Found` for an unknown `id`, otherwise the database-level reason. Present only on the save-failure variant.

e.description: Diagnostic detail about the failure. Present only on the save-failure variant; treat as opaque and do not depend on its shape.

401.description: Authentication failed, or the caller may not save packages.

message.description: Returned when the access token is missing, expired or invalid.

error.description: Returned instead of `message` when the account is authenticated but not permitted to save packages.
